name: Mr. Cuddlesworth
why: Nothing absorbs emotional damage and incoming artillery quite like synthetic fur and polyester stuff

lines.intro: Brace yourselves, here comes pure unadulterated comfort!
lines.hit: Right in the face with soft, fuzzy trauma!
lines.miss: The bear flutters harmlessly to the carpet!
lines.parried: Rejected! Bear hug turned into a bear beatdown!
